integrity.reproducibility: Two independent Python 3 standard-library programs are embedded and their actual outputs are recorded in VERIFICATION.md.

scientific_limitations: The result assumes ordinary zero forcing on the labeled complete prism K_n Cartesian K_2 with integer n>=4; no assertion is made about connected reconfiguration across components or other zero-forcing variants. The minimum forcing set count and complete static membership are prior results, not newly claimed. Computation is exhaustive for the stated finite orders only; the proof establishes the all-n assertion. A historical unindexed equivalent remains possible.
title: Crown-line geometry and frozen universal states in complete-prism zero forcing
